source_documents.title: Aggregation enhanced excimer emission (AEEE) with efficient blue emission based on pyrene dendrimers

reference_evidence_units.quote: When dendrimer D5 was excited at 343 nm, the spectrum displayed monomer emissions at 377 and 398, and excimer emission at 470 nm.
reference_evidence_units.subject: D5

reference_evidence_units.quote: The values were 0.54 in pure THF and 2.66 in the 1 : 9 THF/water mixture.
reference_evidence_units.subject: D5
reference_evidence_units.statement: IE/IM rises from 0.54 to 2.66 on aggregation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: excimer emission is due to intramolecular interactions in high water fraction due to aggregation by increasing the solvent polarity
reference_evidence_units.subject: D5
reference_evidence_units.statement: Excimer from interactions between pyrenes of the same dendrimer.

reference_evidence_units.quote: there is no interaction between the two pyrenyl units in the ground state to form dimers.
reference_evidence_units.subject: dendrimer series

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Aggregation-enhanced pyrene excimer emission (intra- and intermolecular) is the paper's explanation.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Restricted rotation of pyrenyl groups is suggested ('probably') for dendrimer D3a only, not for D5.
